summary: Brisk easterly winds maintain a high risk of rip currents at Franklin County beaches where a persistent longshore flow fosters surf heights up to 2 ft today. Offshore flow makes for a moderate risk at Gulf- Bay-Walton County beaches. This pattern continues for another 2-3 days.
Moderate rip current risk*. Surf height around 2 feet. Partly sunny. Showers likely and a slight chance of thunderstorms. Highs in the upper 70s. Southeast winds around 15 mph.
Moderate rip current risk*. Sunny. Highs in the upper 70s. West winds around 10 mph.
Moderate rip current risk*. Mostly sunny. Highs in the mid 70s. Northwest winds around 10 mph.
Swimming and wading are against the law while double red flags fly (fines apply in Panama City Beach and unincorporated Bay County).
High surf and/or strong currents. Experienced swimmers only, and only close to shore.
Moderate surf and/or currents. Use caution.
Calm conditions. Rip currents can still form near piers, jetties and sandbars.
